error.generic: Something didn't work on our end. Your information is safe — please try again.
error.connection: We can't reach our servers right now. If you need immediate help, the Alzheimer's Helpline is available at 1-800-272-3900.
error.no_access_code: It looks like you haven't set up a care profile yet. Let's get that done — it only takes a few minutes.

login.title: Enter Access Code
login.subtitle: Enter the 8-character access code you received when you set up your care profile, along with your loved one's name.
login.name_hint: Stored only on this device — never sent to our servers.
login.error_not_found: Access code not found. Please check and try again.
login.error_incomplete_code: Please enter your complete 8-character access code.
login.error_missing_name: Please enter your loved one's name.

disclaimer.title: Before you continue
disclaimer.no_diagnosis: It does not diagnose, treat, or provide medical advice.
disclaimer.bullet_doctor: For medical questions, call your doctor
disclaimer.bullet_helpline_lead: For trained human support, call the
disclaimer.ack: CalmGuide uses AI to offer guidance — it's here to help, but it's not a replacement for your doctor or emergency services.

journey_nav.heading: Where are you in the journey?

welcome.tagline: Calm guidance when your loved one needs you most.
welcome.privacy_note: Your conversations are private. No personal data is stored on our servers.

privacy_hint: To protect everyone's privacy, we encourage you to describe behaviors rather than using names or personal details.

language.label: Language
language.auto_detected: We'll use {language} — would you like a different language?

emergency.label: Emergency contacts
emergency.choose_option: Choose the fastest option for urgent support.

restart.title: Restart required
restart.message: Please fully close the app and reopen it to apply the new layout direction.

error_boundary.title: Something went wrong
error_boundary.message: The app encountered an error. Your data is safe.

network.offline_banner: You're offline. We'll keep trying to reconnect.
network.offline_detail: Your message is saved and will send once you're back online. If this is an emergency, call 911.

hero.subtitle: CalmGuide helps family caregivers navigate difficult dementia-related moments with structured, context-aware, and safety-conscious guidance.
hero.disclaimer: Educational and emotional-support tool. Not a medical device, and not a substitute for emergency services.

ai_guided.title: AI-guided support
ai_guided.desc: Structured, step-by-step guidance for the moment you're in.

personalized.title: Personalized context
personalized.desc: Guidance shaped by your loved one's stage, history, and what's worked before.

multilingual.title: Multilingual support
multilingual.desc: Available in English, Spanish, and Hindi.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.desc: Conversation content is encrypted at rest.

what_is.title: Support in the moments that matter most.
what_is.desc: CalmGuide combines what you tell it with your loved one's context, behavioral history, and trusted dementia-care knowledge — screened through safety pathways and refined by your feedback — to offer guidance built for the moment you're in.

describe.title: You describe what's happening
describe.desc: Tell CalmGuide what's happening, in your own words or by voice.

context.title: CalmGuide considers relevant context
context.desc: CalmGuide factors in your loved one's history and what's worked before.

guidance.title: CalmGuide provides structured guidance
guidance.desc: Receive calm, step-by-step guidance built for the moment you're in.

feedback.title: Feedback helps refine future support
feedback.desc: Your feedback shapes better guidance next time.

coach.title: See what Moment Coach offers
coach.subtitle: A preview of the structure behind every response — not a live demo.

right_now.title: Right Now
right_now.desc: Immediate, concrete steps for this moment.

why.title: Why This May Be Happening
why.desc: Possible triggers and context to consider.

when_help.title: When To Get More Help
when_help.desc: Signs that mean it's time to call for support.

not_to_do.title: What Not To Do
not_to_do.desc: Common responses that can make things harder.

behavioral_context.title: Guidance that doesn't start from zero
behavioral_context.desc: CalmGuide can factor in recurring triggers, strategies that have worked before, and feedback you've given — so guidance builds on what you've already learned. Not unlimited memory, just a working picture of what helps.

safety.title: Safety should not depend on a single AI response.
safety.subtitle: CalmGuide screens every input through deterministic checks before any AI-generated guidance is shown.
safety.disclaimer: CalmGuide is not a diagnostic tool. It does not replace clinicians, emergency services, or the Alzheimer's Association 24/7 Helpline.

three_am.title: Designed for real life. Anytime, anywhere.

interop.title: Designed with clinical data standards in mind
interop.desc: CalmGuide's architecture considers FHIR, HL7, OMOP, SNOMED CT, and LOINC as design-time standards for future clinical integration.
interop.caveat: This is not universal EHR integration today — these are standards CalmGuide's data model is designed to be compatible with.

technology.title: Built on a modern, transparent stack

about.body: CalmGuide is built with guidance and support from Leap of Faith Technologies, Frank Naeymi-Rad PhD MBA, John Trzesniak, and David M. Liebovitz MD.

final_cta.title: Ready to explore CalmGuide?
final_cta.desc: Approved users can access the current CalmGuide experience with an authentication code.
